dedupe_keys.name: catalogo de soluciones de adaptacion al cambio climatico basadas en la naturaleza e sbn catalogue of nature based solutions in spain

description: The E:SBN catalogue is a spreadsheet of nature-based solutions for climate change adaptation in Spain, compiled by the project "Systematisation of nature-based solutions in Spain". The Zenodo record read on 2026-09-28 says the project carried out a broad identification and compilation of nature-based solutions across Spain as a reference of good practice for adapting each territory to climate change, with support from the Fundación Biodiversidad of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition under the grant call for projects implementing the National Climate Change Adaptation Plan 2021-2030; the dataset was published on 13 February 2025 as one XLS file of about 300 KB, under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 licence. Coverage is Spain. Access is free download; commercial reuse is not allowed. Caveats: entries are case descriptions of projects, not measured performance, and the catalogue is a one-off release. It supports climate adaptation planning with green and blue infrastructure, such as flood retention and urban cooling measures. Related records: data-urban-nature-atlas-nbs-database and platform-plataforma-de-infraestructura-verde-y-soluciones-basadas-en-la-naturaleza-chile are comparable nature-based solution catalogues.
